crop.notes: Only the end of 'Champion Mitchell in the City'; the headline and opening paragraphs are in the previous column and missing from the crop.

ocr.notes: Minor errors ('Pir! eel theatre' for People's theatre).

title.suggested: Tom Allen calls Charley Mitchell the coming man

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported on English boxer Charley Mitchell's sparring exhibition with Madden at the People's Theatre in St. Louis; Tom Allen, among the old sports present, thought Mitchell the coming man.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Missouri Republican, St. Louis, Monday Morning, June 25, 1883.

facts.fact: Allen attended Charley Mitchell's sparring exhibition with Billy Madden at the People's Theatre in St. Louis and judged Mitchell the coming man

notes: Mitchell's first name comes from the page headline 'Champion Mitchell in the City'/'Arrival of Charley Mitchell'; Madden is identified only by surname in the crop. Allen's view is reported speech, not a direct quote.
